aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Auto uses the first reference image when editing.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Output resolution tier. 4k can take several minutes.

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: Reference image URLs or data URIs, in image 1 through image 10 order. Each must be at least 256 pixels per dimension. Oversized images are automatically downscaled to at most 4 megapixels while preserving aspect ratio. The first controls auto aspect ratio.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: Return the image as a data URI instead of storing it in request history.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to generate an image from.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand the prompt while preserving its intent and reference roles.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
